title: Sony XR-65A80J (65-inch OLED, 2021, device BRAVIA_VH2, model string "BRAVIA 4K VH2"), EU firmware
header:
Sony XR-65A80J (65-inch OLED, 2021, device BRAVIA_VH2, model string "BRAVIA 4K VH2"), EU firmware
Android 12 (Google TV, API 31), build BRAVIA_VH2_EU-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241 release-keys

Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-xr-65a80j/debloat.txt
Undo:  TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-xr-65a80j/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED with pm disable-user --user 0, never uninstalled.
Comment out any package whose feature you use; AirPlay, DLNA and HbbTV are optional choices below.

Based on the same-platform sony-bravia-4k-vh2 and sony-kd-65x80j lists, checked against this TV.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx/.home.HomeActivity.
Live TV / tuner and Sony input app: com.sony.dtv.tvx. USB media: com.sony.dtv.smartmediaapp.
Tested with the separate Cosy Home-based launcher com.cosyhome.tv, not the reference launcher.
The stock launcher was disabled separately after the new launcher was installed and Home verified.
Do not disable launcherx before a working replacement is installed.

Keep TV/input services (com.sony.dtv.tvinput.*, tvapi, sonysystemservice, settingsprovider),
all com.mediatek.* and mtktvapi.agent, the keyboard, Play Store and Play Services.
Keep Bravia Sync/HDMI-CEC and eARC services: com.sony.dtv.braviasync*, HomeTheatreControl,
audiooutput, audiosysteminfoprovider and com.dolby.android.audio.service.
Kept by choice: voice assistant (katniss, voicesearch, assistantadapter), Chromecast (mediashell),
Miracast, firmware updates (systemupdate/update), Ambient mode (dreamx), Living Decor (livingfit),
remote/Bluetooth services, Netflix partner service, and streaming apps except the old MTV app below.

Already disabled in the baseline and deliberately omitted: my5/itv/ard/all4/iplayer/sounds launchers,
com.sony.dtv.homekit, de.hdplus.tvapp.androidtv, com.sony.dtv.promos, com.sony.dtv.seeds.iot,
com.vewd.core.integration.dia, com.apple.atve.sony.appletv, com.youview.poa,
com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic, com.sony.dtv.b2b.vendorprotocol and com.sony.dtv.b2b.softap.

Validation: owner reports a few days of use on Ethernet; batches 1-7 were reboot-checked.
Saved snapshots confirm all 38 listed packages disabled, plus launcherx separately.
Ethernet was used. End-to-end casting and Wi-Fi reconnection are not confirmed by the snapshots.
Source setup and before/after snapshots: https://github.com/samipuro/tv-launcher
